verdict.rationale: Square's Payouts API (list-payouts) lets a business see payout records, and 'Manage your cash flow' hints at cash-flow visibility, but the evidence pack has no documentation of an instant or next-day payout acceleration option that a founder could trigger. Missing for 10: explicit instant/next-day payout feature docs, UI/dashboard evidence of speeding up a payout, and any confirmation of fees/timing for expedited payouts.
